youtube.title: Why Your Jeans Have A Tiny Pocket 👖 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
That tiny pocket on your jeans was made for something almost nobody carries anymore.

The tiny pocket on your jeans was made in the 1800s for pocket watches, so miners and cowboys wouldn't crush or lose them. Wrist watches took over, but the pocket stayed, and Levi's still calls it the watch pocket.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
